title: Here’s my Meta ads creative prediction…
description: Here’s my Meta ads creative prediction…
transcript: I have a meta ads creative trend prediction that I have heard no one else say yet. I worked agency side in the ad industry for years. I've personally spent over $100 million on the platform, worked with hundreds of eight and nine figure brands and this one is new even for me. So meta announced this update at the Performance Marketing Summit a few months ago. Essentially they're going to be having video highlights on their ads, which are kind of like YouTube chapters. Now the prediction I have is that it is going to be way more common to see 3, 5, even up to 10 minute long ads on the platform. I've already seen this work for a few brands that I'm working with, specifically those that are targeting the 50+ demographic. But with the rise of episodic content and the drive for creators to go more long form, I think meta is actually prepping advertisers or the use of that type of content. And I think this is a great thing for meta overall, right? Because they're going to have people on the platform longer and if they can actually get conversions, aka performance out of this type of content, it is a win win for the platform. So what I've been doing recently is actually encouraging my clients to make their best performing ads longer. And if you have a few top performers, literally just stitch them all together like 3 to 4 ads right in A row. So I'm curious, let me know in the comments what the longest ad that you've ever tested on meta is. Mine was like 6 minutes long and it was a banger.
